summary: A workflow_dispatch intended as a BUILD-ONLY validation of the newly-fixed prod deploy pipeline performed a REAL prod deploy. Forgejo Actions silently DROPPED the boolean `dry_run` dispatch input (string "true" via the REST API was not honoured), so DRY_RUN fell back to its UNSAFE default and the gitops image bump ran. Net effect benign and actually the intended end-state: prod advanced from a stuck dashboard-v0.1.32 (the build had been OOMing on the old 2Gi shared runner; PR #394 routed it to the dedicated 8Gi build-runner) to main HEAD 3af3e74394b3 — Argo Synced, workloads Healthy, DB migrations applied clean (fail-closed did not trip), restormel.dev served 200 throughout => NO service degradation, hence NEAR-MISS not incident. Secondary finding: the PBI-lifecycle PostSync hook hit DeadlineExceeded (unbounded curls against a Forgejo saturated by the concurrent build/registry-push) which marked the Argo prod Sync OPERATION Failed even though workloads stayed Healthy. Fixes: keys#395 makes dispatch safe-by-default (choice input `action`, default validate; tag push still a real release); gitops#99 makes the hook timeout-bounded + best-effort (never fails the sync).
